content.comment_body: Hello, I've encountered an issue where I want to multiply one analog variable by another, rather than using a fixed gain. I'm unsure if this can be done in [product_name], so I'd appreciate any confirmation or advice. Thank you!

Hi, With standard analog functions in [product_name], directly multiplying two analog variables isn't possible. However, there is a complex workaround you can use. Please check the attached solution, which works both on actual hardware and in the PC simulation because it only relies on the timing cycle of [product_name]. The calculation takes some time, which depends on the values of A and B and the cycle frequency. Parameters A1 and A2 define the factors (as integers) and can also be set by other program logic. Input I1 is used to trigger a single calculation and I2 to perform continuous A*B multiplication. Kind regards, [user_name]

Thank you, [user_name]. That explanation was very helpful. My only concern now is having enough function blocks available for the math—I've reached around 125 but should be able to optimize some as I refine the software. I appreciate the example you provided!
